name: The Chimp Project
summary:
The Chimp Project is a multiplayer co-op horror game where you and your friends play as apes sent on dangerous scavenging missions. Work together to collect valuable items, survive the hostile environments, and make it back alive—before the night takes you.

Co-op Survival – Team up with your friends to explore eerie maps filled with secrets, traps, and lurking threats.

Scavenge & Escape – Collect loot scattered across abandoned facilities, jungles, and labs while managing time and danger.

Monkey Movement
